categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co., Ltd. operates a complete aluminum processing industry chain including power generation, alumina production, electrolytic aluminum, casting, aluminum profiles, hot-rolled, cold-rolled, and foil rolling. Its product portfolio covers upstream products like electricity, alumina, and aluminum alloy ingots, and downstream products such as aluminum plates and strips (automotive plates, aerospace plates, can materials), aluminum profiles (industrial and architectural), and aluminum foil. The company serves multiple sectors including automotive, aerospace, packaging, construction, and new energy industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced aluminum processing technologies including hot rolling, cold rolling, foil rolling, extrusion for aluminum profiles, and high-end alloy development. It emphasizes innovation-driven development with significant R&D investment in automotive lightweight aluminum, aerospace-grade aluminum, and high-performance battery foils. The company also integrates clean energy and recycling technologies, including high-quality recycled aluminum projects and energy-saving production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers (domestic and international brands such as BMW, Audi, SAIC, NIO), aerospace companies (Boeing, Airbus, COMAC), battery manufacturers (CATL, CALB, Gotion High-Tech), packaging companies, and construction firms. The company targets high-end markets like automotive lightweighting, aerospace materials, and new energy vehicle battery foils, alongside traditional markets such as beverage can materials and industrial aluminum profiles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and major production bases in Shandong Province. It has significant overseas operations including alumina and electrolytic aluminum projects in Indonesia (Bintan Industrial Park), subsidiaries in Australia, the United States, Singapore, Germany, and Hong Kong. This global footprint supports both domestic and international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanshan Aluminium operates an integrated upstream to downstream supply chain in the aluminum industry. It controls upstream raw material production (electricity, alumina, electrolytic aluminum), midstream processing (casting, rolling, extrusion), and downstream high-value-added aluminum products manufacturing. The company also engages in recycling and secondary aluminum production, forming a closed-loop aluminum industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven, high-end manufacturing and deep processing of aluminum products. It prioritizes R&D in automotive lightweight materials, aerospace aluminum alloys, and high-performance battery foils. It is expanding overseas production capacity, especially in Indonesia, and advancing green, low-carbon, and circular economy initiatives. The company also emphasizes shareholder returns through dividends and share repurchases.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of aluminum products across the value chain, including upstream products like alumina and electrolytic aluminum, and downstream products such as automotive plates, aerospace plates, aluminum profiles, and foils. The company also earns income from power generation and trading activities. Export sales and domestic direct sales constitute the main sales channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanshan Aluminium is positioned as a leading domestic aluminum deep-processing enterprise with strong market share in automotive aluminum plates and aerospace aluminum materials. It competes with other large aluminum producers and processors in China and internationally, including Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad. The company leverages its integrated supply chain, technological innovation, and global footprint to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 28.84 billion, a 17.47% decrease from 2022, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.47 billion, slightly down by 1.18%. Total assets reached RMB 68.82 billion, up 6.32% year-over-year. Despite revenue decline due to weak overseas demand and price drops, the company maintains solid profitability and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanshan Aluminium emphasizes high-quality, high-performance aluminum products tailored for automotive lightweighting, aerospace, and new energy sectors. Its integrated industry chain, advanced technology, and strong R&D capabilities enable it to offer differentiated products with superior strength, corrosion resistance, and lightweight features. The company also focuses on green manufacturing and recycling, aligning with sustainability trends to provide environmentally friendly aluminum solutions.
